pulse_title: Supply pulse — USGS world mine production (kg Pd, annual)

product.description: Palladium, unwrought or in powder form (also 7110.29 semi-manufactured; 7112 scrap/autocat)

coverage_note: Annual country mine production from USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries platinum-group metals chapter. No free official monthly world palladium mine series. Recycling (autocatalysts) is material but not in the mine table — see recycling note.

sources.name: USGS MCS 2026 platinum-group metals
sources.covers: 2024 and 2025e world mine production; US salient; import sources 2021–24; recycling note

world_by_year.note: MCS 2025 finalized 2023. MCS 2026 revised later years upward for Russia/SA.
MCS 2026 significantly revised 2024 Russia (89,000) and South Africa (82,600) vs MCS 2025 2024e.
Published Feb 2026. Russia + SA ~81% of world mine output. US down sharply on Stillwater restructuring.

us_salient.end_use_note: Leading US use is automotive catalytic converters; also chemical/petroleum catalysts, electronics, dental/medical, glass, investment, jewelry (USGS MCS 2026).

recycling_2025_usgs.note: USGS: ~140,000 kg of palladium and platinum recovered globally from new and old scrap in 2025, including ~50,000 kg Pd and 8,600 kg Pt from US autocatalysts.

us_imports_2021_24.note: Share of US palladium imports, not of world mine production. Jul 2025 AD/CVD petition froze RU flows temporarily; USITC 29 May 2026 negative injury determination means Commerce will not issue AD/CVD orders (USITC Pub. 5749).

gaps: No official monthly world palladium mine production series (USGS MCS is annual, published each January/February).
USGS does not publish company-level splits (Nornickel vs Amplats vs Impala vs Sibanye) in the world table.
Recycling tonnes are lumped Pd+Pt globally in MCS text; not a clean monthly secondary-supply series.
Russian export destination mix after US AD/CVD (2025) is trade-press / company reporting, not a free official monthly pipe.
SA company quarterly reports are 6E/4E basket ounces — convert carefully to Pd-only kg.
